detail: Federal tax on gasoline cut by R$0.63/l (total federal tax left R$0.16/l); hydrous ethanol PIS/Cofins zeroed (R$0.19/l). Replaced a R$0.44/l gasoline subsidy that ended 9 Sep.
effect_on_ethanol_parity: Lower gasoline pump price caps what hydrous can charge at the pump (70% rule); the ethanol tax cut offsets part of it

detail: Gasoline federal tax cut raised from R$0.63 to R$0.89/l (PIS/Pasep, Cofins and Cide at zero); hydrous ethanol tax cut kept at R$0.19/l; subsidy to ethanol producers raised from R$0.25 to R$0.43/l.
effect_on_ethanol_parity: The producer subsidy adds to mill ethanol revenue: about 2¢/lb sugar-equivalent at R$0.43/l

detail: PIS/Pasep and Cofins stay at zero on gasoline (Cide also zero) and on hydrous ethanol; extraordinary subsidy of R$0.428 per litre of hydrous ethanol to producers and co-operatives, to 9 December 2026.
effect_on_ethanol_parity: Lapse on 9 Dec would lift gasoline by the R$0.89/l of tax and take the R$0.428/l subsidy away from mills: watch for a further extension
